verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client and design/testing tool. It covers requests, collections, mocks, spec design and the Inso CLI, not a gateway that sits in the path of production traffic. Enforcing per-consumer or per-route rate limits is a gateway capability, so this story is a category error for this product type. The mention of connecting to Konnect for 'protecting requests' describes a separate Kong product, not a rate-limiting feature of Insomnia itself.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce rate limits on API traffic per consumer or route
